CREATE TABLE `user`
            (
              `userId` int UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL, `name` varchar (20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'no name', `nickName` varchar (20) NULL, `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`userId`), UNIQUE KEY (nickName)
            )

CREATE TABLE `stock`
            (
              `id` int UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `user` int UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `post` int UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY (user,post), CONSTRAINT ref_stock_user__user_userId FOREIGN KEY(user) REFERENCES `user`(`userId`), CONSTRAINT ref_stock_post__post_postId FOREIGN KEY(post) REFERENCES `post`(`postId`) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE NO ACTION
            )
